<!--
  albertprofe.dev long-scroll landing (PREVIEW, branch landing-preview).
  Adapted from wiki-team/landing/landing-prototype.html.
  All numbers below were computed from the repo on 2026-11-01 (commit fd2575d7):
    - 415 .qmd pages  -> git ls-files '*.qmd' | wc -l
    - 77 labs         -> selab*, sblab*, rjslab*, lilab*, scrumlab*, mulab*, devops-lab-*
    - 84 book pages   -> books/*.qmd
    - 11 course editions -> ifc*/ folders
    - 1,673 commits since 2022-12-08 -> git log
    - 165 students -> about 15 per course edition x 11 editions (Albert's figure)
    - Per-area page counts -> git ls-files '<area>/*.qmd'
  Course facts (260h, 14/09–27/11/2026, 11 weeks, Sprint#09) are hardcoded from courses-db
  (courses + calendar tabs; local db/*.csv copies must match). Hours/sprints-done % is
  recomputed when the sprint rolls: class hours through today / 260, completed sprints / 11.
  Update the "Now" + hero stats every week when the sprint rolls over.
-->

```{=html}
<style>
  /* ---------- landing only: scoped under #lp so the rest of the site keeps cosmo/darkly ---------- */
  /* Palette follows Quarto's toggle: body.quarto-light (cosmo) / body.quarto-dark (darkly).
     Light is the default, like Quarto (darkModeDefault = false). Dark values = the original dark landing. */
  body {
    --bg: #f8fafc; --bg-card: #ffffff; --bg-card-hover: #ffffff;
    --accent: #2563eb; --accent-light: #2563eb; --accent-2: #16a34a; --accent-3: #9333ea;
    --text: #0f172a; --text-muted: #475569; --strong: #0f172a; --on-accent: #ffffff;
    --header-bg: rgba(255,255,255,.78); --header-border: rgba(15,23,42,.08);
    --line-08: rgba(15,23,42,.07); --line-10: rgba(15,23,42,.08); --line-12: rgba(15,23,42,.09); --line-15: rgba(15,23,42,.12);
    --outline: rgba(15,23,42,.18);
    --code-bg: rgba(37,99,235,.08); --code-fg: #1e40af;
    --green-bg: rgba(22,163,74,.10); --green-border: rgba(22,163,74,.35); --green-fg: #15803d; --green-soft: rgba(22,163,74,.06);
    --live-border: rgba(22,163,74,.45);
    --spin-bg: rgba(37,99,235,.09); --spin-border: rgba(37,99,235,.30); --spin-fg: #1e3a8a;
    --hover-border: rgba(37,99,235,.30); --btn-shadow: rgba(37,99,235,.30);
    --pill-bg: rgba(37,99,235,.08); --pill-border: rgba(37,99,235,.22); --pill-hover-bg: rgba(37,99,235,.16); --link-hover: #1e40af;
    --sprint-grad: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(37,99,235,.06), rgba(147,51,234,.05)); --sprint-border: rgba(37,99,235,.20);
    --day-bg: #ffffff; --final-tint: rgba(37,99,235,.06);
    --shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(15,23,42,.04), 0 4px 16px -4px rgba(15,23,42,.08);
    --shadow-hover: 0 2px 4px rgba(15,23,42,.04), 0 16px 32px -10px rgba(37,99,235,.22);
    --header-shadow: 0 1px 12px rgba(15,23,42,.05); --header-blur: blur(16px) saturate(1.4);
    background: var(--bg) !important; overflow-x: hidden;
  }
  body.quarto-dark {
    --bg: #0b0f1a; --bg-card: #111827; --bg-card-hover: #1a2236;
    --accent: #3b82f6; --accent-light: #60a5fa; --accent-2: #22c55e; --accent-3: #a855f7;
    --text: #f8fafc; --text-muted: #94a3b8; --strong: #fff; --on-accent: #f8fafc;
    --header-bg: rgba(11,15,26,.82); --header-border: rgba(59,130,246,.15);
    --line-08: rgba(148,163,184,.08); --line-10: rgba(148,163,184,.1); --line-12: rgba(148,163,184,.12); --line-15: rgba(148,163,184,.15);
    --outline: rgba(148,163,184,.3);
    --code-bg: rgba(96,165,250,.12); --code-fg: #bfdbfe;
    --green-bg: rgba(34,197,94,.12); --green-border: rgba(34,197,94,.3); --green-fg: #86efac; --green-soft: rgba(34,197,94,.06);
    --live-border: rgba(34,197,94,.35);
    --spin-bg: rgba(59,130,246,.15); --spin-border: rgba(59,130,246,.35); --spin-fg: #fff;
    --hover-border: rgba(59,130,246,.3); --btn-shadow: rgba(59,130,246,.4);
    --pill-bg: rgba(59,130,246,.12); --pill-border: rgba(59,130,246,.25); --pill-hover-bg: rgba(59,130,246,.25); --link-hover: #fff;
    --sprint-grad: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(59,130,246,.10), rgba(168,85,247,.08)); --sprint-border: rgba(96,165,250,.25);
    --day-bg: rgba(11,15,26,.7); --final-tint: rgba(59,130,246,.07);
    --shadow: none; --shadow-hover: none; --header-shadow: none; --header-blur: blur(16px);
  }
  #quarto-header, .nav-footer, #quarto-margin-sidebar, .quarto-title-block { display: none !important; }
  #quarto-content, main.content, #quarto-document-content { padding: 0 !important; margin: 0 !important; max-width: none !important; }
  #lp {
    font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
    background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); line-height: 1.6; font-size: 16px;
  }
  #lp * { box-sizing: border-box; }
  #lp a { text-decoration: none; }
  #lp p { margin: 0; }
  #lp h1, #lp h2, #lp h3 { color: var(--text); border: 0; margin-top: 0; }
  /* header */
  #lp .lp-header { position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; z-index: 1000; background: var(--header-bg);
    backdrop-filter: var(--header-blur); -webkit-backdrop-filter: var(--header-blur); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--header-border);
    box-shadow: var(--header-shadow);
    padding: .75rem 2rem; display: flex; flex-wrap: nowrap; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; }
  #lp .lp-logo { flex-shrink: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .6rem; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.2rem; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -.02em; color: var(--text); white-space: nowrap; }
  #lp .lp-logo span { color: var(--accent-light); }
  #lp .lp-logo span.lp-logo-w { color: inherit; }
  #lp .lp-logo-icon { flex-shrink: 0; width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 10px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent), var(--accent-3)); font-size: 1.05rem; color: var(--on-accent); }
  /* nav: middle/right, never wraps */
  #lp .lp-nav { flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-wrap: nowrap; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 1.5rem; }
  #lp .lp-nav a { color: var(--text-muted); font-size: .9rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; white-space: nowrap; transition: color .2s; }
  #lp .lp-nav a:hover { color: var(--text); }
  /* right-hand group: menu button (small screens) + theme toggle + Sprint CTA */
  #lp .lp-actions { flex-shrink: 0; display: flex; flex-wrap: nowrap; align-items: center; gap: .75rem; }
  #lp .lp-actions .lp-btn { white-space: nowrap; padding: .6rem 1.25rem; font-size: .9rem; line-height: 1; }
  /* sun/moon toggle + hamburger: same round icon button */
  #lp .lp-theme, #lp .lp-menu-btn { flex-shrink: 0; width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 9999px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--outline); color: var(--text-muted); cursor: pointer; padding: 0; transition: all .2s; }
  #lp .lp-theme:hover, #lp .lp-menu-btn:hover, #lp .lp-menu-btn[aria-expanded="true"] { color: var(--accent-light); border-color: var(--accent-light); }
  #lp .lp-theme:focus-visible, #lp .lp-menu-btn:focus-visible, #lp .lp-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-light); outline-offset: 2px; }
  #lp .lp-theme svg, #lp .lp-menu-btn svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; }
  #lp .lp-theme .lp-sun { display: none; }
  body.quarto-dark #lp .lp-theme .lp-sun { display: block; }
  body.quarto-dark #lp .lp-theme .lp-moon { display: none; }
  #lp .lp-menu-btn { display: none; }
  #lp .lp-menu-btn .lp-x { display: none; }
  #lp .lp-menu-btn[aria-expanded="true"] .lp-x { display: block; }
  #lp .lp-menu-btn[aria-expanded="true"] .lp-bars { display: none; }
  /* 760-1100px: tighter, hide lower-priority links */
  @media (max-width: 1100px) {
    #lp .lp-header { padding: .7rem 1.25rem; }
    #lp .lp-logo { font-size: 1.1rem; }
    #lp .lp-nav { gap: 1rem; }
    #lp .lp-nav a { font-size: .85rem; }
    #lp .lp-nav a.lp-pri-low { display: none; }
    #lp .lp-actions { gap: .6rem; }
    #lp .lp-actions .lp-btn { padding: .55rem 1.05rem; font-size: .85rem; }
  }
  /* below 760px: links collapse into a dropdown under the header */
  @media (max-width: 760px) {
    #lp .lp-header { padding: .6rem 1rem; gap: .5rem; }
    #lp .lp-logo { font-size: 1.05rem; gap: .5rem; }
    #lp .lp-logo-icon { width: 32px; height: 32px; font-size: .95rem; }
    #lp .lp-menu-btn { display: inline-flex; }
    #lp .lp-theme, #lp .lp-menu-btn { width: 34px; height: 34px; }
    #lp .lp-actions { gap: .5rem; }
    #lp .lp-actions .lp-btn { padding: .5rem .85rem; font-size: .8rem; }
    #lp .lp-cta-arrow { display: none; }
    #lp .lp-nav { display: none; position: absolute; top: 100%; left: 0; right: 0; flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; gap: 0;
      padding: .4rem 1rem .8rem; background: var(--bg); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--header-border); box-shadow: 0 12px 24px -12px rgba(15,23,42,.25); }
    #lp .lp-nav.lp-open { display: flex; }
    #lp .lp-nav a, #lp .lp-nav a.lp-pri-low { display: block; padding: .8rem .25rem; font-size: 1rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line-10); }
    #lp .lp-nav a:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
  }
  @media (max-width: 440px) { #lp .lp-logo-w { display: none; } }
  @media (max-width: 340px) { #lp .lp-logo-icon { display: none; } }
  #lp .lp-current { margin: 0 0 1.5rem; padding: 1rem 1.25rem; border: 1px solid var(--green-border); border-radius: 14px; background: var(--green-soft); display: grid; gap: .5rem; }
  #lp a.lp-badge { text-decoration: none; }
  /* buttons */
  #lp .lp-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .4rem; padding: .7rem 1.5rem; border-radius: 9999px;
    font-weight: 600; font-size: .95rem; transition: all .25s; border: none; }
  #lp .lp-btn-primary { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent), var(--accent-3)); color: #fff !important; }
  #lp .lp-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 10px 25px -5px var(--btn-shadow); }
  #lp .lp-btn-outline { background: transparent; color: var(--text) !important; border: 1px solid var(--outline); }
  #lp .lp-btn-outline:hover { border-color: var(--accent-light); color: var(--accent-light) !important; }
  /* sections */
  #lp section { position: relative; z-index: 1; padding: 6rem 2rem; max-width: 1100px; margin: 0 auto; }
  #lp .lp-label { display: inline-block; font-size: .8rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--accent-light); margin-bottom: 1rem; }
  #lp h1 { font-size: clamp(2.8rem, 6vw, 4.4rem); font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.1; letter-spacing: -.03em; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; }
  #lp h2 { font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 4vw, 2.6rem); font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -.02em; margin-bottom: 1.25rem; }
  #lp h3 { font-size: 1.2rem; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: .6rem; }
  #lp .lp-lead { font-size: 1.2rem; color: var(--text-muted); max-width: 680px; margin-bottom: 2rem; }
  #lp .lp-muted { color: var(--text-muted); font-size: .95rem; }
  #lp code { background: var(--code-bg); color: var(--code-fg); padding: .1rem .35rem; border-radius: 4px; font-size: .88em; }
  /* hero */
  #lp .lp-hero { min-height: 100vh; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: center;
    text-align: center; padding-top: 6rem; }
  #lp .lp-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .5rem; background: var(--green-bg);
    border: 1px solid var(--green-border); color: var(--green-fg); padding: .4rem 1rem; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: .85rem;
    font-weight: 500; margin-bottom: 2rem; }
  #lp .lp-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--accent-2); box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(34,197,94,.7); animation: lp-pulse 2s infinite; }
  @keyframes lp-pulse { 70% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 10px rgba(34,197,94,0); } 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(34,197,94,0); } }
  #lp .lp-grad-code { color: var(--accent-light); } #lp .lp-grad-learn { color: var(--accent-2); } #lp .lp-grad-build { color: var(--accent-3); }
  #lp .lp-spin { display: inline-block; width: 13ch; text-align: center; white-space: nowrap; vertical-align: middle; line-height: 1.5;
    padding: .05rem .5rem; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--spin-bg); border: 1px solid var(--spin-border); color: var(--spin-fg);
    font-weight: 700; font-size: .95em; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; transition: opacity .25s ease; }
  #lp .lp-hero-sub { display: block; margin-top: 1.4rem; }
  /* cinematic hero: image, orbiting chips, glass card (dark in both themes) */
  #lp .lp-cine { max-width: 1280px; min-height: min(92vh, 780px); padding: 7rem 2.5rem 3.5rem; display: flex; flex-direction: row;
    align-items: center; justify-content: flex-start; text-align: left; isolation: isolate;
    --text: #f8fafc; --text-muted: #c4b5fd; --strong: #fff; --outline: rgba(196,181,253,.35); --accent-light: #60a5fa;
    --spin-bg: rgba(168,85,247,.18); --spin-border: rgba(196,181,253,.35); --spin-fg: #fff;
    --green-bg: rgba(34,197,94,.14); --green-border: rgba(34,197,94,.35); --green-fg: #86efac;
    --chip-fg: #fff; --chip-bg: rgba(30,27,75,.55); --cine-img: url("images/landing/hero-orbit.jpg"); }
  #lp .lp-cine-media { position: absolute; inset: 5rem 1rem 1rem; border-radius: 1.5rem; overflow: hidden; z-index: -1;
    background: #0b0f1a var(--cine-img) right center / cover no-repeat;
    box-shadow: 0 30px 80px -30px rgba(88,28,135,.55); }
  #lp .lp-cine-media::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(11,15,26,.78) 0%, rgba(11,15,26,.35) 42%, rgba(11,15,26,0) 70%); }
  #lp .lp-orbit { position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 2; pointer-events: none; }
  #lp .lp-chip { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .45rem; white-space: nowrap;
    padding: .36rem .8rem .36rem .55rem; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: .84rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .01em;
    color: var(--chip-fg); background: var(--chip-bg); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--c) 55%, transparent);
    will-change: transform, opacity; pointer-events: auto; text-decoration: none; backface-visibility: hidden; }
  #lp a.lp-chip { cursor: pointer; }
  #lp a.lp-chip:hover, #lp a.lp-chip.is-frozen { color: var(--chip-fg); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--c) 22%, var(--chip-bg)); }
  #lp a.lp-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--c, #60a5fa); outline-offset: 3px; }
  #lp .lp-orbit .lp-chip { pointer-events: auto; }
  #lp .lp-chip svg { width: 1.15em; height: 1.15em; fill: none; stroke: var(--c); stroke-width: 1.6; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; flex: none; }
  #lp .lp-glass { position: relative; z-index: 2; max-width: 540px; padding: 2.2rem 2.3rem; border-radius: 1.5rem;
    background: rgba(17,12,40,.55); border: 1px solid rgba(196,181,253,.28);
    backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(1.3); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(1.3);
    box-shadow: 0 20px 60px -20px rgba(0,0,0,.6); }
  #lp .lp-cine h1 { font-size: clamp(2.4rem, 5vw, 3.8rem); margin-bottom: 1.1rem; }
  #lp .lp-cine .lp-lead { font-size: 1.08rem; color: #e9e5ff; margin-bottom: 0; }
  #lp .lp-cine .lp-badge { margin-bottom: 1.4rem; }
  #lp .lp-cine .lp-hero-ctas { justify-content: flex-start; margin-top: 1.8rem; }
  #lp .lp-cine .lp-stats {
    display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
    justify-content: stretch; align-items: start; gap: 1.15rem 1.6rem; margin-top: 2rem; width: 100%; max-width: 34rem;
  }
  @media (max-width: 520px) {
    #lp .lp-cine .lp-stats { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 1rem 1.1rem; }
  }
  #lp .lp-cine .lp-stat { text-align: left; }
  #lp .lp-cine .lp-stat-value { font-size: 1.25rem; }
  #lp .lp-cine .lp-stat-label { color: #c4b5fd; font-size: .75rem; }
  body:not(.quarto-dark) #lp .lp-cine {
    --text: #0f172a; --text-muted: #4c1d95; --strong: #0f172a; --outline: rgba(91,33,182,.30); --accent-light: #2563eb;
    --spin-bg: rgba(147,51,234,.10); --spin-border: rgba(147,51,234,.30); --spin-fg: #4c1d95;
    --green-bg: rgba(22,163,74,.10); --green-border: rgba(22,163,74,.30); --green-fg: #15803d;
    --chip-fg: #1e1b4b; --chip-bg: rgba(255,255,255,.72); --cine-img: url("images/landing/hero-orbit-light.jpg"); }
  body:not(.quarto-dark) #lp .lp-cine-media { background-color: #f5f3ff; box-shadow: 0 30px 80px -35px rgba(91,33,182,.35); }
  body:not(.quarto-dark) #lp .lp-cine-media::after { background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(248,250,252,.75) 0%, rgba(248,250,252,.25) 42%, rgba(248,250,252,0) 70%); }
  body:not(.quarto-dark) #lp .lp-glass { background: rgba(255,255,255,.62); border-color: rgba(147,51,234,.22); box-shadow: 0 20px 60px -25px rgba(76,29,149,.35); }
  body:not(.quarto-dark) #lp .lp-cine .lp-lead { color: #334155; }
  body:not(.quarto-dark) #lp .lp-cine .lp-stat-label { color: #6d28d9; }
  @media (max-width: 900px) {
    #lp .lp-cine { flex-direction: column; padding: 5.5rem 1rem 2rem; min-height: 0; }
    #lp .lp-cine-media { position: relative; inset: auto; width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; background-position: 70% center; }
    #lp .lp-cine-media::after { background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(11,15,26,0) 55%, rgba(11,15,26,.55) 100%); }
    body:not(.quarto-dark) #lp .lp-cine-media::after { background: none; }
    #lp .lp-glass { max-width: none; width: 100%; margin-top: -2.5rem; padding: 1.6rem 1.4rem; }
    #lp .lp-chip { font-size: .72rem; padding: .28rem .6rem; }
  }
  @media (max-width: 480px) { #lp .lp-chip { font-size: .64rem; } }
  #lp .lp-hero-ctas { display: flex; gap: 1rem; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center; margin-top: 2.2rem; }
  #lp .lp-stats { display: flex; gap: 3rem; margin-top: 4rem; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center; }
  #lp .lp-numbers { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 1.1rem; margin-top: 2rem; }
  #lp .lp-num { background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--line-12); border-radius: 1rem; padding: 1.4rem 1.5rem;
    box-shadow: var(--shadow); transition: transform .2s, border-color .2s, box-shadow .2s; }
  #lp .lp-num:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); border-color: var(--hover-border); box-shadow: var(--shadow-hover); }
  #lp .lp-num-icon { font-size: 1.3rem; line-height: 1; margin-bottom: .7rem; }
  #lp .lp-num-value { font-size: 2.4rem; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.05; letter-spacing: -.02em;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent-light), var(--accent-3)); -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text; color: transparent; }
  #lp .lp-num-label { font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text); margin-top: .35rem; }
  #lp .lp-num-src { font-size: .82rem; color: var(--text-muted); margin-top: .15rem; }
  @media (max-width: 860px) { #lp .lp-numbers { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); } }
  @media (max-width: 420px) { #lp .lp-numbers { gap: .75rem; } #lp .lp-num { padding: 1.1rem; } #lp .lp-num-value { font-size: 1.9rem; } }
  #lp .lp-stat { text-align: center; }
  #lp .lp-stat-value { font-size: 2rem; font-weight: 800; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent-light), var(--accent-3));
    -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent; }
  #lp .lp-stat-label { font-size: .85rem; color: var(--text-muted); margin-top: .25rem; }
  /* cards */
  #lp .lp-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(260px, 1fr)); gap: 1.5rem; margin-top: 2.5rem; }
  #lp .lp-card { display: block; background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--line-10); border-radius: 1rem;
    padding: 1.75rem; transition: all .25s; color: var(--text); box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
  #lp a.lp-card:hover, #lp .lp-card:hover { background: var(--bg-card-hover); border-color: var(--hover-border); transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-hover); }
  #lp .lp-card.lp-live { border-color: var(--live-border); }
  #lp .lp-live-tag { font-size: .75rem; color: var(--green-fg); vertical-align: middle; }
  #lp .lp-card-icon { font-size: 1.8rem; margin-bottom: 1rem; }

  <!-- The problem -->
  <section id="path" class="lp-reveal">
    <div class="lp-label">Why this wiki</div>
    <h2>Learning fails when the path is invisible</h2>
    <p class="lp-lead">Class notes get lost. Sprint goals stay only in the teacher's head. Students don't see the full journey, and the link between "today" and "the whole course" breaks.</p>
    <div class="lp-split">
      <div class="lp-split-card teacher">
        <h3>What the teacher needs</h3>
        <ul class="lp-list">
          <li>A living Sprint Backlog that is easy to update every day</li>
          <li>A Product Backlog that keeps the full history</li>
          <li>Clear marks: <code>++</code> new topic, <code>----</code> pending to future</li>
          <li>One place that links commits, masterDocs, diagrams and labs</li>
        </ul>
      </div>
      <div class="lp-split-card student">
        <h3>What the student needs</h3>
        <ul class="lp-list">
          <li>Know exactly what we did today and what comes next</li>
          <li>See the whole roadmap, not only the current day</li>
          <li>Find reference articles and previous labs quickly</li>
          <li>Feel progress instead of guessing</li>
        </ul>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- The solution -->
  <section class="lp-reveal">
    <div class="lp-label">The connection</div>
    <h2>One shared path. Visible to both.</h2>
    <p class="lp-lead">Every course edition follows the same pattern: Official docs · Sprint Backlog · Product Backlog · Calendar &amp; Deliveries. The Sprint is the live plan for the week; when the week ends it is pasted into the Product Backlog and a new Sprint starts.</p>
    <div class="lp-grid">
      <a class="lp-card" href="ifcd0021-26/ifcd0021-backlog-sprint-26.html"><div class="lp-card-icon">🗂</div><h3>Sprint Backlog</h3>
        <p class="lp-muted">The plan for this week, day by day, with numbered steps. <code>++</code> for new topics, <code>----</code> for what moves to the future.</p></a>
      <a class="lp-card" href="ifcd0021-26/ifcd0021-backlog-product-26.html"><div class="lp-card-icon">🗃</div><h3>Product Backlog</h3>
        <p class="lp-muted">The permanent history. Every finished week is pasted here, month by month, so the full journey stays visible.</p></a>
      <a class="lp-card" href="ifcd0021-26/ifcd0021-deliveries-26.html"><div class="lp-card-icon">📅</div><h3>Calendar &amp; Deliveries</h3>
        <p class="lp-muted">Official dates, evaluation weights (30% continuous, 70% final) and how to deliver the exercises.</p></a>
      <a class="lp-card" href="ifcd0021-26/ifcd0021-26.html"><div class="lp-card-icon">📜</div><h3>Official Docs</h3>
        <p class="lp-muted">The Certificat de Professionalitat: modules, hours and the general competence of the course.</p></a>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- Methodology -->
  <section id="method" class="lp-reveal">
    <div class="lp-label">The weekly rhythm</div>
    <h2>How we keep the path alive</h2>
    <div class="lp-steps">
      <div class="lp-step"><div class="lp-step-num">1</div><div><h3>Plan the Sprint</h3><p class="lp-muted">Monday: write the sprint header and the daily topics with numbered steps.</p></div></div>
      <div class="lp-step"><div class="lp-step-num">2</div><div><h3>Update every day</h3><p class="lp-muted">Mark progress, add <code>++</code> for new topics, strike what we skip, link the commit and the masterDoc.</p></div></div>
      <div class="lp-step"><div class="lp-step-num">3</div><div><h3>Close the week</h3><p class="lp-muted">Paste the finished week into the Product Backlog. Start a fresh Sprint.</p></div></div>
      <div class="lp-step"><div class="lp-step-num">4</div><div><h3>Students always see the truth</h3><p class="lp-muted">The pages the teacher updates are the pages students open. No hidden plan. <a href="scrum/scrum-what-concepts.html" style="color:var(--accent-light)">Why SCRUM →</a></p></div></div>

      <div class="lp-mark"><b>++</b>new topic not planned</div>
    </div>
  </section>

<script>
(function () {
  // hero orbit: one throttled rAF loop, transform/opacity only; pause off-screen
  (function () {
    var box = document.getElementById('lp-orbit'); if (!box) return;
    var chips = box.querySelectorAll('.lp-chip'), n = chips.length;
    if (!n) return;
    var t0 = performance.now(), raf = 0, last = 0, onScreen = true;
    var FRAME_MS = 33, RETURN_MS = 750;
    var COS_T = Math.cos(-0.18), SIN_T = Math.sin(-0.18);
    var mq = window.matchMedia ? window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)') : null;
    var st = [], mw = [], mh = [], boxW = 0, boxH = 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      st[i] = { frozen: false, x: 0, y: 0, s: 1, o: 1, fromX: 0, fromY: 0, fromS: 1, fromO: 1, returnStart: 0 };
      mw[i] = 0; mh[i] = 0;
    }
    function measure() {
      boxW = box.clientWidth; boxH = box.clientHeight;
      for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) { mw[i] = chips[i].offsetWidth; mh[i] = chips[i].offsetHeight; }
    }
    function write(i, x, y, s, o, z) {
      var rec = st[i];
      rec.x = x; rec.y = y; rec.s = s; rec.o = o;
      chips[i].style.transform = 'translate3d(' + x.toFixed(1) + 'px,' + y.toFixed(1) + 'px,0) scale(' + s.toFixed(3) + ')';
      chips[i].style.opacity = o.toFixed(2);
      chips[i].style.zIndex = z;
    }
    function freeze(i) {
      st[i].frozen = true;
      st[i].returnStart = 0;
      chips[i].classList.add('is-frozen');
    }
    function unfreeze(i, now) {
      if (!st[i].frozen && !st[i].returnStart) return;
      var rec = st[i];
      rec.frozen = false;
      rec.fromX = rec.x; rec.fromY = rec.y; rec.fromS = rec.s; rec.fromO = rec.o;
      rec.returnStart = (mq && mq.matches) ? 0 : now;
      chips[i].classList.remove('is-frozen');
    }
    function resetInteractions() {
      for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        st[i].frozen = false;
        st[i].returnStart = 0;
        chips[i].classList.remove('is-frozen');
        chips[i].blur();
      }
      var ae = document.activeElement;
      if (ae && ae.classList && ae.classList.contains('lp-chip')) ae.blur();
      box.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
      void box.offsetWidth;
      box.style.pointerEvents = '';
    }
    chips.forEach(function (c, i) {
      c.addEventListener('mouseenter', function () { freeze(i); });
      c.addEventListener('mouseleave', function () { unfreeze(i, performance.now()); });
      c.addEventListener('focus', function () { freeze(i); });
      c.addEventListener('blur', function () { unfreeze(i, performance.now()); });
    });
    function easeOutCubic(u) { return 1 - Math.pow(1 - u, 3); }
    function place(now) {
      var W = boxW, H = boxH;
      if (!W || !H) return;
      var narrow = W < 900;
      var cx = W * (narrow ? .62 : .64), cy = H * .52;
      var rx = W * (narrow ? .33 : .27), ry = H * (narrow ? .30 : .26);
      var t = (now - t0) / 1000 * 0.16;
      for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        var rec = st[i];
        var a = t + i * 2 * Math.PI / n, x = Math.cos(a) * rx, y = Math.sin(a) * ry;
        var X = cx + x * COS_T - y * SIN_T, Y = cy + x * SIN_T + y * COS_T;
        var depth = (Math.sin(a) + 1) / 2;
        var liveX = X - mw[i] / 2, liveY = Y - mh[i] / 2;
        var liveS = 0.78 + depth * 0.32, liveO = 0.45 + depth * 0.55;
        if (rec.frozen) { chips[i].style.zIndex = 5; continue; }
        if (rec.returnStart) {
          var u = (now - rec.returnStart) / RETURN_MS;
          if (u >= 1) { rec.returnStart = 0; u = 1; }
          else u = easeOutCubic(Math.max(0, u));

            rec.fromS + (liveS - rec.fromS) * u, rec.fromO + (liveO - rec.fromO) * u, 4);

        }
        write(i, liveX, liveY, liveS, liveO, depth > .5 ? 3 : 1);

  // sun/moon toggle: use Quarto's own switch so the choice is shared with the whole site
  var tbtn = document.getElementById('lp-theme');
  if (tbtn) tbtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
    if (typeof window.quartoToggleColorScheme === 'function') { window.quartoToggleColorScheme(); return; }
    var dark = !document.body.classList.contains('quarto-dark');
    try { window.localStorage.setItem('quarto-color-scheme', dark ? 'alternate' : 'default'); } catch (e) {}
    document.body.classList.toggle('quarto-dark', dark);
    document.body.classList.toggle('quarto-light', !dark);
  });
  // hamburger menu (below 760px)
  var mbtn = document.getElementById('lp-menu-btn'), mnav = document.getElementById('lp-nav');
  function lpMenu(open) { mnav.classList.toggle('lp-open', open); mbtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open ? 'true' : 'false'); mbtn.setAttribute('aria-label', open ? 'Close menu' : 'Open menu'); }
  if (mbtn && mnav) {
    mbtn.addEventListener('click', function () { lpMenu(mbtn.getAttribute('aria-expanded') !== 'true'); });
    mnav.addEventListener('click', function (e) { if (e.target.closest('a') && !e.target.closest('.lp-dd-menu')) lpMenu(false); });
    document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) { if (e.key === 'Escape' && mbtn.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true') { lpMenu(false); mbtn.focus(); } });
    document.addEventListener('click', function (e) { if (!e.target.closest('.lp-header')) lpMenu(false); });
    window.addEventListener('resize', function () { if (window.innerWidth > 760) lpMenu(false); });
  }
  // Topics dropdown: click toggle (needed on touch/mobile; desktop also gets CSS :hover)
  var tdd = document.getElementById('lp-topics-dd'), tbtn = document.getElementById('lp-topics-btn');
  function lpTopics(open) {
    if (!tdd || !tbtn) return;
    tdd.classList.toggle('open', open);
    tbtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open ? 'true' : 'false');
  }
  if (tdd && tbtn) {
    tbtn.addEventListener('click', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); lpTopics(tbtn.getAttribute('aria-expanded') !== 'true'); });
    tdd.addEventListener('click', function (e) { if (e.target.closest('a')) { lpTopics(false); if (mbtn && window.innerWidth <= 760) lpMenu(false); } });
    document.addEventListener('click', function (e) { if (!e.target.closest('#lp-topics-dd')) lpTopics(false); });
    document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) { if (e.key === 'Escape') lpTopics(false); });
  }
  // rotating word, same list as the previous home page
  var words = ['JAVA','REACT','SPRING BOOT','UML','BASH','MINDSET','SCRUM','LINUX','API REST','DEVOPS','AWS','MARKDOWN','QUARTO'];
  var spin = document.getElementById('lp-spin'), k = 0;
  setInterval(function () { spin.style.opacity = 0; setTimeout(function () { k = (k + 1) % words.length; spin.textContent = words[k]; spin.style.opacity = 1; }, 250); }, 1600);
  // reveal on scroll
  var els = document.querySelectorAll('#lp .lp-reveal');
  if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
    var io = new IntersectionObserver(function (es) { es.forEach(function (e) { if (e.isIntersecting) { e.target.classList.add('lp-in'); io.unobserve(e.target); } }); }, { threshold: 0.12 });
    els.forEach(function (el) { io.observe(el); });
  } else { els.forEach(function (el) { el.classList.add('lp-in'); }); }
})();
</script>
```
